text:
anya (Product): Quick pass of the company-level OKR draft for FY27 is up — link: https://docs.redwood.ai/okr/fy27-draft. Want cross-functional sign-off by EOD Fri so we can publish to the org.

sam (CEO): Skimmed — big Q: are we prioritizing Dedicated revenue expansion or Private (VPC/on-prem)? needs to be explicit in the narrative.

jordan (VP Product): Proposal in doc is to prioritize Dedicated (predictable ARR) this quarter, keep Private as a key enterprise pipeline play — suggest we call out 60/40 split in the PRD.

maria (Finance): 60/40 is fine if Sales commits to attach rates. We need conservative revenue uplift figures in KRs (not optimistic). I'll add a model row.

cleo (Eng): Heads up: Dedicated capacity work will collide with runtime refactor 3 — we only have one squad able to own both. Timeline looks tight (10w) unless we cut scope.

lee (Design): Also FYI design estimates are 2 sprints for Dedicated UX + 1 for admin console changes. If Eng needs to slide, we'll need to reprioritize.

ria (Security): For Private/VPC we need an initial compliance gating list (KYC, KMS integration, audit logs). That adds 3 weeks to delivery unless we scope pilot.

anya (Product): Thanks — here's a short gate checklist I pasted into the doc to help sign-off (keeping it minimal):

```
- Business: pilot customers committed (2 enterprise logos)
- Revenue: sales attach & conservative ARR forecast approved by Finance
- Engineering: dedicated squad confirmed or scope reduced (<=8w)
- Security: KMS + audit logging verification completed
- Legal: contract template with data terms ready
- GTM: sales + customer success enablement doc ready
```

jordan (VP Product): Can we change GA KR to "pilot + rollout plan" instead of full GA? That buys time for Security/Legal while keeping momentum.

cleo (Eng): +1 for pilot-first. If we scope to a pilot (2 customers), I can promise the 8w timeline. Full GA will need resource ramp or extra sprints.

maria (Finance): Pilot-first acceptable. I will update KR targets to pilot revenue and then conditional GA uplift in Q+1. Need final numbers by Thurs COB to bake into the forecast.

sam (CEO): Sounds pragmatic. Can we get an explicit go/no-go matrix in the doc for EOD Fri? I want the exec checklist to be binary.

anya (Product): Will add a 5-point go/no-go matrix (Sales commit, Security pass, Eng owner, Pricing approved, Pilot customer LOIs). Will post updated link in ~2 hours.

lee (Design): I'll attach mockups and a short design acceptance checklist.

ria (Security): I'll sign off on the security row once KMS integration plan is approved.

sam (CEO): Cool. If we get that matrix and numbers by Fri, I can sign off. :thumbsup:

anya (Product): Thanks everyone — scheduling a 20m sync Fri 9:30 to do final run. Posting updated doc shortly. :calendar:
